Vox.md is a local-first quick capture app for Obsidian vaults and Markdown folders. Send text, links, photos, files, document scans, sketches, and voice to the right note without stopping to organize first.

CAPTURE MORE THAN VOICE

Add typed Markdown, a URL, photos or screenshots, files, a document scanner with on-device OCR, a sketch, or a voice recording. Combine several items in one capture, preview the result, then save it as plain Markdown.

SEND IT WHERE IT BELONGS

Capture Presets remember the destination and formatting for workflows such as your inbox, journal, task list, or meeting notes. Create a note, append or prepend to an existing file, insert beneath a heading, or write to rolling daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly notes.

Each preset can keep its own template, metadata, attachment folder, filename rules, placement, and processing preferences. Override a destination or template for one capture without changing the preset.

CAPTURE FROM MORE PLACES

Use Vox.md from the app, Share Sheet, custom keyboard, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Shortcuts, or Apple Watch. Pending and failed deliveries remain available for retry, so a temporary folder permission or sync issue does not lose your work.

PRIVATE VOICE TRANSCRIPTION

Transcribe speech into text on your device with Apple Speech, Whisper, or Parakeet, depending on your settings and device. Audio and transcripts are never sent to Vox.md servers. Use offline dictation and voice typing from the custom keyboard, record on Apple Watch, or export transcripts as TXT, Markdown, JSON, or YAML.

PLAIN FILES, NO LOCK-IN

Vox.md writes standard Markdown to the folders and Obsidian vaults you choose. You do not need an account or a proprietary notes database. Your files remain readable in any Markdown app.

New Capture and transcription require paid access. Choose Individual or Family: weekly, yearly, or lifetime. Eligible subscriptions include a seven-day free trial, then renew automatically at the displayed price until canceled in Apple Account settings. Existing purchases remain valid. Viewing and exporting existing history require no new purchase.

PRIVACY

Capture contents, exported notes, audio, transcripts, keystrokes, file paths, and bookmarks are not sent to Vox.md servers. Vox.md collects limited, privacy-safe onboarding analytics to understand setup problems. Microphone, camera, photo, and file access are used only when you choose those capture types.

—

ΠΩΣ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΕΙ

—

ΧΑΡΑΚΤΗΡΙΣΤΙΚΑ

• Τοπική μεταγραφή — τροφοδοτείται από το Whisper AI, μηδέν δεδομένα αποστέλλονται οπουδήποτε
• Λειτουργεί σε κάθε εφαρμογή — οποιοδήποτε πεδίο κειμένου που χρησιμοποιεί το τυπικό iOS πληκτρολόγιο

• Ιστορικό μεταγραφών — κάντε κύλιση πίσω σε όλα όσα έχετε υπαγορεύσει
• Πολλαπλά μοντέλα Whisper — επιλέξτε ανάμεσα σε Tiny, Base και Small ανάλογα με την προτίμησή σας για ταχύτητα/ακρίβεια

—

Οι νέες καταγραφές και μεταγραφές απαιτούν πρόσβαση επί πληρωμή. Επιλέξτε ατομική ή οικογενειακή πρόσβαση: εβδομαδιαία, ετήσια ή εφ’ όρου ζωής. Οι συνδρομές που πληρούν τις προϋποθέσεις περιλαμβάνουν επτά ημέρες δωρεάν δοκιμής και στη συνέχεια ανανεώνονται αυτόματα στην εμφανιζόμενη τιμή, μέχρι να ακυρωθούν στις ρυθμίσεις του λογαριασμού Apple. —

ΙΔΙΩΤΙΚΟΤΗΤΑ

Όλη η επεξεργασία ήχου συμβαίνει στο iPhone σας χρησιμοποιώντας τοπική μηχανική μάθηση. Καμία ηχογράφηση, μεταγραφή ή προσωπικά δεδομένα δεν μεταδίδονται ποτέ σε εξωτερικούς διακομιστές. Η πρόσβαση στο μικρόφωνο απαιτείται για μεταγραφή και χρησιμοποιείται μόνο όταν ξεκινάτε ενεργά την εγγραφή.

Είναι επίσης χρήσιμο για: ιδιωτικότητα, σημειώσεις, ήχος.

ค่าจับภาพที่ตั้งไว้จะจำปลายทาง เทมเพลต เมทาดาทา ไฟล์แนบ และตำแหน่ง ใช้ Vox.md จากแอป แผ่นแชร์ แป้นพิมพ์แบบกำหนดเอง วิดเจ็ต คำสั่งลัด หรือ Apple Watch รายการที่รอส่งยังคงพร้อมให้ลองใหม่

การแปลงเสียงเป็นข้อความทำงานบนอุปกรณ์ด้วย Apple Speech, Whisper หรือ Parakeet เสียง ข้อความถอดเสียง เนื้อหาที่พิมพ์ เส้นทางไฟล์ และบุ๊กมาร์กจะไม่ถูกส่งไปยังเซิร์ฟเวอร์ Vox.md โดย Vox.md จะเขียน Markdown มาตรฐานลงในโฟลเดอร์และคลัง Obsidian ที่คุณเลือก โดยไม่ต้องมีบัญชีหรือฐานข้อมูลโน้ตเฉพาะ

การบันทึกและถอดเสียงใหม่ต้องมีสิทธิ์ใช้งานแบบชำระเงิน เลือกแบบบุคคลหรือครอบครัว: รายสัปดาห์ รายปี หรือตลอดชีพ การสมัครสมาชิกที่มีสิทธิ์จะได้ทดลองฟรีเจ็ดวัน จากนั้นจะต่ออายุอัตโนมัติตามราคาที่แสดงจนกว่าจะยกเลิกในการตั้งค่าบัญชี Apple การซื้อเดิมยังคงใช้ได้ การดูและส่งออกประวัติเดิมไม่ต้องซื้อใหม่

attributes.description:
Vox.md é um teclado de voz para texto offline para reconhecimento de voz e escrita por voz.

Toque no botão do microfone em qualquer aplicação, fale naturalmente, e as suas palavras aparecem como texto. Tudo é processado no dispositivo usando Apple Silicon, portanto nada sai jamais do seu telefone.

—

COMO FUNCIONA

Vox.md adiciona um botão de voz ao seu teclado iOS. Quando quer ditar, toque no microfone, fale, e Vox.md transcreve a sua voz directamente no campo de texto — em Mensagens, Notas, Safari, ou qualquer aplicação que aceita um teclado.

—

FUNCIONALIDADES

• Transcrição no dispositivo — alimentada pela IA Whisper, zero dados enviados para qualquer lugar
• Funciona em toda aplicação — qualquer campo de texto que usa o teclado iOS padrão
• Modo de escuta sempre activo — inicie uma sessão da aplicação principal, depois use ditado mãos livres em qualquer aplicação
• Histórico de transcrição — role para trás através de tudo o que ditou
• Múltiplos modelos Whisper — escolha entre Tiny, Base e Small dependendo da sua preferência velocidade/precisão

—

Novas capturas e transcrições exigem acesso pago. Escolha um plano individual ou familiar: semanal, anual ou vitalício. As assinaturas elegíveis incluem sete dias de avaliação gratuita e depois renovam-se automaticamente ao preço apresentado até serem canceladas nas definições da Conta Apple. As compras existentes continuam válidas. Consultar e exportar o histórico existente não exige uma nova compra.

—

PRIVACIDADE

Todo o processamento de áudio acontece no seu iPhone usando aprendizagem automática no dispositivo. Nenhuma gravação de áudio, transcrição ou dados pessoais são jamais transmitidos para servidores externos. Acesso ao microfone é necessário para transcrição e é usado apenas quando inicia activamente uma gravação.

Também é útil para: local.

A Vox.md hang gombot ad az iOS billentyűzetéhez. Amikor diktálni szeretne, koppintson a mikrofonra, beszéljen, és a Vox.md közvetlenül a szövegmezőbe írja át a hangját — Üzenetekben, Jegyzetekben, Safariban vagy bármely alkalmazásban, amely billentyűzetet fogad.

• Eszközön történő átírás — Whisper AI-vel működtetve, nulla adat küldése bárhová
• Minden alkalmazásban működik — bármely szövegmező, amely a szabványos iOS billentyűzetet használja
• Mindig aktív figyelő mód — indítson munkamenetet a főalkalmazásból, majd használja a kéz nélküli diktálást bármely alkalmazásban
• Átírási előzmények — görgessen végig mindenen, amit diktált
• Több Whisper modell — válasszon Tiny, Base és Small között a sebesség/pontosság preferenciája szerint

Vox.md este o tastatură voce-în-text offline, pe dispozitiv pentru recunoașterea vocii și tastarea vocală.

—

CUM FUNCȚIONEAZĂ

Vox.md adaugă un buton de voce la tastatura dvs. iOS. Când doriți să dictați, atingeți microfonul, vorbiți și Vox.md transcrie vocea dvs. direct în câmpul de text — în Mesaje, Notițe, Safari sau orice aplicație care acceptă o tastatură.

• Funcționează în toate aplicațiile — orice câmp de text care folosește tastatura iOS standard
• Mod de ascultare mereu activ — începeți o sesiune din aplicația principală, apoi folosiți dictarea fără mâini în orice aplicație
• Istoric transcriere — derulați prin tot ce ați dictat
• Modele Whisper multiple — alegeți între Tiny, Base și Small în funcție de preferința dvs. de viteză/acuratețe

—

CAPTURE MORE THAN VOICE

Add typed Markdown, a URL, photos or screenshots, files, a document scanner with on-device OCR, a sketch, or a voice recording. Combine several items in one capture, preview the result, then save it as plain Markdown.

SEND IT WHERE IT BELONGS

Capture Presets remember the destination and formatting for workflows such as your inbox, journal, task list, or meeting notes. Create a note, append or prepend to an existing file, insert beneath a heading, or write to rolling daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, or yearly notes.

Each preset can keep its own template, metadata, attachment folder, filename rules, placement, and processing preferences. Override a destination or template for one capture without changing the preset.

CAPTURE FROM MORE PLACES

Use Vox.md from the app, Share Sheet, custom keyboard, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Shortcuts, or Apple Watch. Pending and failed deliveries remain available for retry, so a temporary folder permission or sync issue does not lose your work.

PLAIN FILES, NO LOCK-IN

Vox.md writes standard Markdown to the folders and Obsidian vaults you choose. You do not need an account or a proprietary notes database. Your files remain readable in any Markdown app.
